name: jury-and-budget
body: Jury mode is opt-in, one token by default. Extra tokens on a bot answer the same prompt; one is flagged primary and compares blind (shuffled A/B/C), with selection tracked after. Cost multiplier is shown plainly. Context budget is a fill bar on the bot, not a cap: persona plus skill file against the window. Crossing it turns red; you can still cross. Demo worth keeping: the models fight it out on screen.
